from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AccountsPayableRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's 应付账款 (Accounts Payable) figure for a reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    accounts_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The 应付账款 amount in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    accounts_payable_records: list[AccountsPayableRecord]
